title: Lathe's checks run first, then the product's, each by position
when: Loads a product with three check rows of its own beside Lathe's checks.
then: Expects every problem of Lathe's checks before the first of the product's, and the product's in their position order.

title: The rail lists the products in order with their icons or monograms
when: Reads the icon and color fields of several values, the monograms and derived colors of two IDs, and the spaces of Notebook and Demo shop in a workspace of three products.
then: Expects `iconField` to keep an emoji or up to two characters and give none for `far too long`, `ABC` and an empty value; the monograms `TL` and `LA`; `colorField` to keep `#335577` and refuse `url(x)`; `colorOf` the same every time for one ID and different for `TL` and `LA`; and Notebook's space colored `#335577` while Demo shop's takes its derived color.

title: Alt and a number switch spaces, and the palette has Switch to commands
when: From the products picker of a workspace of three products, presses Alt+3, Alt+1, then Alt+4.
then: Expects Alt+3 to open `/NF` and announce `Switched to Notebook`, Alt+1 to open `/AB`, and Alt+4, with no fourth space, left alone (not default-prevented) with the page still `/AB`.

title: The current space is the page's product and is marked
when: Asks which product owns a note's page, a UC requirement's, a group's, a product's with Checks over it, the format reference and the products picker.
then: Expects `NF` for `/NF-NOTE` and the product page `/NF`, `DM` for `/DM-SHOP-UC01-R01` and the group page `/DM-SHOP/use_case`, and none for the old format address `/format` and the products picker `/`.

title: The current page's branch opens itself
when: Opens a UC requirement's page.
then: Expects the `Use cases of Shopping` list open with the `Buying` capability linking to `/DM-SHOP-CAP01`, and no `Interaction design of Shopping` list open.

title: Folder names and order come from the schema sections, in the nav and on the domain page alike
when: Renames the Test plan stage to Tests and checks and puts it first in the schema, then opens Shopping's page.
then: Expects the `Folders of Shopping` list to read Tests and checks (2) first, then Domain model (4), Use cases (1), Interaction design (2), Technical specification (2) and Open questions (1).

title: A capability's flows and tests sit in their folders, its use cases under it
when: Reads the folders and branches of a domain with two use cases under one capability, and the product's Shared folders.
then: Expects Shopping's folders to hold one aggregate, specification, read model, term, capability, endpoint, table, command handler, invariant test and use case test, both use cases' flows (`DM-SHOP-UC01-FL01`, `DM-SHOP-UC02-FL01`) in Flows and `DM-SHOP-Q01` in Open questions; the second use case's branch to open only Use cases, a command's Domain model's Aggregates, a flow step's Interaction design's Flows, and a value object's constraint the product's Shared Domain model; and the product's Shared to hold Value objects in Domain model and Interfaces and Views in Interaction design.

title: A kind in no known folder gets a folder of its own
when: Adds a product's own kind in Domain model and one of no stage, each with a record in Shopping, then reads Shopping's folders and the kinds' folder paths.
then: Expects Risks last in Shopping's Domain model, after Aggregates, Specifications, Read models and Terms; Memos after Open questions outside the stages; and the folder paths `Use cases` for a use case, `Domain model` for a risk and none for a question.

title: What is folded is remembered for the session, and every record is listed without sections
when: Unfolds Shopping's Test plan in the nav, then opens the product's page with Checks over it.
then: Expects Shopping's Test plan to list one folder per kind, in the schema's order: Invariant tests (1), then Use case tests (1).

title: A record with no owner sits in the one domain that uses it, in its stage and folder, with what sits under it, and in Shared otherwise
when: With the model fixture, where only P-D's flow uses the view and the integration, the UI component renders that view, and both domains have fields typed by the value object, reads P-D's and the product's folders and the branches of the view and the value object.
then: Expects the view, integration, UI component and adapter in P-D's folders, the view's branch opening P-D's Interaction design, and the value object with its constraint, value type and test in the product's Shared folder.

title: A record with several kinds of child has a labeled, counted group per kind
when: Reads the groups of the test workspace's domain, aggregates, stages and folders, and of a workspace where a command joins an aggregate of one entity.
then: Expects the domain's child kinds; `Entities (3)` and `Commands (2)` for an aggregate with several kinds of child; no entity group for Shelf's one entity until a command joins it, then `Commands (1)`; stage and folder labels such as `Technical specification (9)` and `Tables (3)` with the folder's members; plural labels such as `Open questions`; a group's ID parsed into its parent, kind and path and naming no record; and only the tree's groups as graph nodes.

title: A group can be the focus: its parent and all its members are shown, and depth counts levels from it
when: Centers on the Aggregates folder.
then: Expects the Aggregates folder at distance 0 with its stage and its four aggregates and the spine through it; at depth 2 the members' groups (`P-D-A3/entity`, `P-D-A4/command`, `P-D-A4/entity`) but not their members, which come at depth 3; nothing for a group the tree does not have (`P-D/flow`, `P-D/use_case`); and the addresses `/P-D/domain-model/aggregate`, `/P-D/domain-model` and `/P-D-UC01`.

title: The graph's tree is the nav's tree
when: Reads the graph's tree of the test workspace from the product down through its Shared folder, a domain's stages and folders, a capability, a use case and an aggregate.
then: Expects a domain's stages and folders in the nav's order and counts, Capabilities as one list, a capability's use cases as its children with its test in the Test plan, Interaction design split by kind, Technical specification's layers then components, the product's Shared folder before its domains, and every child's parent to be the node that lists it.

title: The layout gives the same map every time, whatever the focus, with no overlaps
when: Builds the map of the test workspace twice.
then: Expects the same map for the same index and the same places and sizes for an index built again, no two boxes overlapping, and the nav's order within a level.

title: The page draws the map in columns with a solid parent/child spine, and draws no link between siblings
when: Opens a flow step's graph, then an aggregate's entities.
then: Expects the flow left of its step and a solid spine; then the three sibling entities that link to each other in one column, with no link drawn between them.

title: Every group is in the map with all its members beside it, and the spine runs record, group, record
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2.
then: Expects its stages and folders as groups with their counts, the spine running through a group to its records, and every group in the map holding all its members right beside it and spanning them exactly.

title: Siblings of mixed kinds share a column
when: Frames the Domain model stage at depth 2, then reads the map's levels and places of the domain's records.
then: Expects the aggregates, specification, read model, domain service and term in one column, and every node with the same parent in one column; in the map, records straight in folders of different stages (`P-D-A1`, `P-D-UC01-FL01`, `P-D-EN02-TB`, `P-D-INV01-T`) at one level, the capability `P-D-CAP01` at the level of the other stages' folders, and the four aggregates at one x.

title: Ancestors sit to the left of the focus and descendants to its right
when: Frames a use case at depth 3, then reads the map's places of its ancestors from the product down.
then: Expects the capability, the use case and its requirement in columns 0, 1 and 2 of the framed picture, and in the map each of the product, domain, Use cases stage, capability, use case and requirement further right than the one before.

title: A group sits in its own column between its parent and its members
when: Builds the map of a workspace where an aggregate has both entities and a command.
then: Expects the Aggregates folder one level after the Domain model stage, the aggregate `P-D-A4` one after the folder, its entity group one after it and level with the query `P-D-QRY01`, and the entity `P-D-EN06` one after its group.

title: Within a column nodes follow their parent's place, then the nav's order, and keep it when the graph re-centers
when: In a workspace where an aggregate has both entities and a command, frames the aggregates folder and the domain at depth 2 and reads each node's row and place.
then: Expects `P-D-A1` before `P-D-A4` (the nav's order) and their groups following them, `P-D-A4`'s entities before its commands, the domain's five stages in rows 0 to 4 with each stage's folders in kind order, and the rows in each column numbered from 0 and placed top to bottom in the product's map.

title: Focusing a child leaves every box of the tree map at the same place and size
when: Opens a domain's graph, framed at once, clicks its use cases stage.
then: Expects the camera to glide there over several frames and end framing it, every box drawn before and after at the same place and size, and Back gliding back.

title: A parent spans its children stacked, an equal part each, from its top edge to its bottom edge, each child beside it, nothing overlapping
when: Builds the maps of three workspaces, two synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one.
then: Expects every root the product box's height, every parent's children of one height, stacked from its top to its bottom a tenth of each one's part apart, each in the next level right of it, no two boxes in a level overlapping, the busy part and the quiet one the same height with the busy one's children smaller, and the tree the nav's.

title: A parent line runs level from the parent's right edge to the child's left edge, at the child's middle
when: Draws the parent line of every node of the test workspace's map.
then: Expects every parent line of the map level at its child's middle, from the parent's right edge to the child's left edge.

title: Each product has its own graph map
when: Builds Demo shop's space and its map in a workspace that links into Notebook, then opens a use case's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects Demo shop's map to have Demo shop as its single root and only its nodes, a record of no product to root a map of its own, and the graph to draw nothing of Notebook.

title: A map is laid out off the main thread, again only when what it reads changes, the map before it shown until the new one arrives
when: Packs a product's map's input and lays it out as the worker does; reads it again from new data that changes nothing it reads and from data that does; and shows a map through a worker answered by hand while new data arrives.
then: Expects the worker's layout to equal the page's, the same input for unchanged data and a new one for a changed title, measure or layout, kept fits to lay out as fresh ones do, and the map shown, with the index it was laid out from, to stay until the new layout arrives.

title: A change moves only its parent's region in the Tree map, and siblings keep their order
when: Lays out a tree and a product's Tree map, then adds, removes, renames and moves a record (a parent's first and last child too), and gives a record a problem, and lays it out again.
then: Expects every box outside the changed parents' regions at the same place, size and text scale, the changed parents' own boxes unmoved, nothing moved by a problem badge appearing, and the siblings in their order with a new one at its place.

title: The graph reads left to right by column
when: Builds the test workspace's map.
then: Expects one x and one width per level of the map, levels left to right a gap apart, and ancestors to the left of a record.

title: Every box in a column has its width, a fixed fraction of the map
when: Checks every box of the test workspaces' Tree maps, two synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one.
then: Expects every root at x 0 and the product box's full width, no box wider than `MAX_ASPECT` (6) times its height, siblings sharing one width, the lesser of `MAX_COLUMN_SHARE` (0.4) of their parent's width and 6 times their height, starting `COLUMN_GAP_SHARE` (0.15) of that width after the parent, and the map as wide as its columns; and the busy part's children narrower (6 times their height) than the quiet part's (0.4 of their parent's width) and further left.

title: Tall parents carry their height and text scale, every box its text scale as its box scale, and every parent line is level
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain taller than its stages stacked with a text scale above 1, every drawn box's box scale its text scale, and every parent line drawn level.

title: Each box's text scale is set by the map, at most a fixed share of its column's width
when: Draws the test workspace's map framed on a domain at a quarter, one and four times the framing zoom.
then: Checks every box's text scale is at most its column's width over 400, set by the map, and that at a quarter, one and four times a domain's framing zoom every drawn box carries no text size of its own: the camera never changes a label.

title: In the Tree map siblings share one text scale, their column's width's share or the largest at which every sibling's label fits, and every label fits its box
when: In the Tree maps of three workspaces and three synthetic trees.
then: Expects every group of siblings to share one width, height and text scale, above 0 and equal to the least of their labels' largest fits within their column's width over `TEXT_SIZE` (400); and, in a product with a busy part and a quiet one, the quiet part's child `q0` below its column's share for its long title while the busy and quiet parts keep one text scale.

title: In the Nested map siblings share the largest text scale at which every label fits its box
when: Lays out every test map and a product with a busy part and a quiet one, then the test workspace's Nested map twice.
then: Expects every group of siblings to share one text scale, above 0, at most their side over `TEXT_SIZE` (400) and equal to the least of their labels' largest fits (a leaf's in its square, a parent's in a header band `HEADER_SHARE` (0.25) of its side), and the parents among them one header band, the tallest of their labels; a long title in a busy part lowering its leaf's and its cousin's scale but not its parent's; and the same map object for an index whatever the focus.

title: Every title in Lathe's spec and the Tool Library wraps on whole words, an identifier too wide for a line only at its punctuation or camelCase words
when: Reads every record of Lathe's own spec and the Tool Library's, wraps each title as its box would (in its kind's shape's room).
then: Expects the lines to give the title back, every line but the last to end after a space or, inside one word too wide for a line, after a hyphen, an identifier's punctuation or between its camelCase words.

title: A framed box's header reads at the same size on screen at every depth
when: Loads the repo's own specs (Lathe and the Tool Library) and, in each layout, frames every box at depth 1 in a 770 by 640 frame with the real camera.
then: Expects every frame within `MIN_ZOOM` and `MAX_ZOOM`; the framed title's median size on screen the same at every depth in Nested and within a ratio of 1.2 in the Tree (counting each parent but the product whose text its column sets and whose frame its columns' width sets, in its own frame), and between 9 and 20 pixels; and the smallest box of each map framed short of `MAX_ZOOM`.

title: Each label line is placed in map units at its face's size times its box's text scale, inside its box
when: For every box of the Tree and Nested maps of the test workspace.
then: Expects each label line's size to be its face's at text scale 1 times the box's text scale, and the whole line inside its box, and every badge inside its box. On the page, expects each drawn line's font on screen to be its map size times the zoom, and a box whose title is under `BLOCK_BELOW_PX` on screen drawn as a plain block. Expects the canvas's measure to read each width once at its face's font, and the plain measure to be the same every time.

title: A label the open space cuts is laid out in the box's visible part, else drawn as placed and cut by the edge, never missing
when: Draws a domain's box 900 px wide in the test workspace's Tree map with the open space covering none of it, all but its right 300 px, and all but its right 20 px.
then: Expects the label as placed in the first; in the second its title whole, each line inside the visible part, centered in it, at no more than its own size and at least 9 px; and in the third, a box mostly off screen, its title painted where the map placed it.

title: A focused box is never left without its label: the camera moves to where its visible part holds it
when: Frames a domain's box 900 px wide with the open space covering all but its right 20 px, and again with it covering only its left third.
then: Expects the camera that already draws the label kept as it is, and the cut one moved right, at the same zoom, by the least that draws the label (a pixel less and it is not drawn).

title: The Nested map holds each box's children below its header band, top-down from the product's fixed square, siblings equal squares
when: Lays out every test map, two synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one, then the test workspace's Tree and Nested maps.
then: Expects a leaf's header band 0; every child one level below its parent, inside its padding and below its header band, after it in the keyboard's order, with no two siblings overlapping; and the Nested map's roots and each node's children the Tree map's, in the same order.

title: Children are a grid of equal squares in the tree's order, with the column count that makes them largest
when: Fits four, five and three squares into rooms of several shapes, tries every column count for several counts, and walks every test map's children.
then: Expects four squares in a square room to be two by two, five in a wide room one row, three in a square room two columns with a blank cell and the gap taken off the side, no column count giving larger squares than the one chosen, and in every test map each parent's children in the tree's order, row by row, a gap apart.

title: The Nested map gives siblings one header band and keeps each label inside its square or band
when: Lays out every test map and a product with a busy part and a quiet one, then the test workspace's Nested map twice.
then: Expects every group of siblings to share one text scale, above 0, at most their side over `TEXT_SIZE` (400) and equal to the least of their labels' largest fits both ways (centered in its square and in a header band `HEADER_SHARE` (0.25) of its side), and the parents among them one header band, the tallest of every sibling's label as a parent's; a long title in a busy part lowering its leaf's and its cousin's scale but not its parent's; and the same map object for an index whatever the focus.

title: A change moves only its parent's region in the Nested map, and siblings keep their order
when: Lays out a tree and a product's Nested map, then adds, removes, renames and moves a record, gives a record its first child and takes a last child away (beside a sibling with the longest label too), and gives a record a problem, and lays it out again.
then: Expects every box outside the changed parents' regions at the same place, size, text scale and header band, nothing moved by a problem badge appearing, and the siblings in their reading order with a new one at its place.

title: Depth counts levels of the tree below the focus, stages and folders included, with the parent kept
when: Frames a requirement at depths 1 to 3 (the same picture: it has nothing below it), the Use cases stage at each depth (its capabilities, their use cases, their requirements), the Domain model stage at depth 1 (its folders), and an aggregate.
then: Expects a requirement at depth 1 or 3 to show only it and its use case; the Use cases stage at depths 1, 2 and 3 to add its capability, then the use case, then its requirements; the Domain model stage at depth 1 its folders but not their records; distances 1, 2 and 3 for the capability, use case and requirement; an aggregate at depth 1 its folder and its entity but not its sibling `P-D-A1`; and only parent edges.

title: The glide follows the shared easing: CSS's ease, read from the motion tokens
when: Walks the shared easing curve, a pan with no zoom halfway through its time, and the motion tokens as the stylesheet may write them.
then: Checks the easing curve against CSS's ease walked finely, a pan halfway through the time most of the way there, and the motion tokens parsed as the stylesheet writes them.

title: The camera frames the focus and the levels the depth shows below it, the parent at the left edge
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2, a stage at depth 3, a use case and a short group in a wide level, each in its own frame, on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus whole within the canvas's height, no box under the focus's parent cut by the top, bottom or right edge, the parent in view in a strip at the left edge with the focus right of it, every frame within `MAX_ZOOM`, a deeper frame of the domain never zooming in further, a requirement framed short of `MAX_ZOOM`, and the whole map fitting the overview's height.

title: Focusing a child glides the camera there over several frames, and Back glides back
when: Opens a domain's graph, framed at once, clicks its use cases stage.
then: Expects the camera to glide there over several frames and end framing it, every box drawn before and after at the same place and size, and Back gliding back.

title: Under reduced motion focusing frames the new focus at once
when: Asks for reduced motion, clicks a requirement in its use case's graph.
then: Expects one camera move, straight to the framed view.

title: Depth counts levels below a domain and a use case, as a file explorer does
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 to 3.
then: Expects its stages, then their folders, then what is in them, one level more each time; and a use case in a capability, its capability the only node above it at every depth.

title: The glide is one smooth zoom and pan, from the view as it is to the framed one
when: Builds the zoom path from a domain's frame to a requirement's on the test workspace's map, and the glide's duration for a short path and a long one.
then: Expects the zoom path between a domain's frame and a requirement's to start and end at those views, its zoom changing smoothly between frames, and its duration the shared speed for a short path and at most twice it for a long one.

title: Every drawn box is a named keyboard stop in column order, and the summary counts the framed picture
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 3 with sixty requirements a few pixels tall.
then: Expects every drawn box to show its kind and ID line and its title, and every box in the keyboard layer to be drawn, with an accessible name, a Tab stop and not hidden from assistive technology; the keyboard order over every drawn box, column by column; and the summary counting the framed picture.

title: In the Nested view the camera frames the focus box, whatever the depth, and draws each box with its label
when: Frames a domain, a stage and a record in the Nested map on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus's box centered and within the padding, every drawn box only its ID (its label always drawn), a parent drawn before its children, nothing drawn out of view or under 3 pixels, and the drawing within its budget.

title: The camera frames every box of a real product within its zoom limits, the deepest leaf included
when: Loads the repo's own specs (Lathe and the Tool Library) and, in each layout, frames every box at depth 1 in a 770 by 640 frame with the real camera.
then: Expects every frame within `MIN_ZOOM` and `MAX_ZOOM`; the framed title's median size on screen the same at every depth in Nested and within a ratio of 1.2 in the Tree (counting each parent but the product whose text its column sets and whose frame its columns' width sets, in its own frame), and between 9 and 20 pixels; and the smallest box of each map framed short of `MAX_ZOOM`.

title: A focus with many children is framed whole, its children shown as far as they fit
when: Lays out a 6:1 Tree map of a product with six parents, one holding two children, one eight (each with two of its own) and one forty; frames each at depths 1 to 3 in a 1000 by 800, a 547 by 600 and a 1400 by 1000 pane.
then: Expects the focus whole: its left edge at least the frame's padding in from the pane's, the rest inside the pane, and its first child beside it.

title: Every box of Lathe's and the Tool Library's spec, framed as the focus on the Tree, Nested and Map, is whole on screen
when: Frames every box of both products' Tree and Nested maps as the focus at depths 1 to 3 (the Tree) in a 770 by 640 and a 1200 by 800 pane, and every box of their Maps.
then: Expects each focus wholly inside the pane, over more than a thousand frames.

title: A leaf is framed short of the camera's zoom limit, and the whole map fits the overview
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2, a stage at depth 3, a use case and a short group in a wide level, on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus whole within the canvas's height, no box under the focus's parent cut by the top, bottom or right edge, the parent in view in a strip at the left edge with the focus right of it, every frame within `MAX_ZOOM`, a deeper frame of the domain never zooming in further, a requirement framed short of `MAX_ZOOM`, and the whole map fitting the overview's height.

title: Only boxes in view and big enough are drawn, each with its label, with bars for the rest, within a budget
when: Frames a domain, then views the map at `MIN_ZOOM`, with and without a forced requirement.
then: Expects, framed on the domain, the domain and its Domain model stage drawn and only boxes in view and at least `MIN_DRAWN` (3) pixels tall, each drawn as its ID alone; at `MIN_ZOOM` no box too small and a bar for each run of tiny children, in its parent's children's column and within its parent; the forced requirement drawn whatever its size; and the same view drawing the same.

title: Every drawn box carries its kind and ID line and its title, and is a keyboard stop
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 3 with sixty requirements a few pixels tall.
then: Expects every drawn box to carry its kind and ID line and its title (drawn unless it is a block below the readable size), and every box in the keyboard layer to be drawn, with an accessible name, a Tab stop and not hidden from assistive technology; the keyboard order over every drawn box, column by column; and the summary counting the framed picture.

title: At any zoom a drawn box carries no text size of its own: the camera never resizes a label
when: Draws the test workspace's map framed on a domain at a quarter, one and four times the framing zoom.
then: Checks every box's text scale is at most its column's width over 400, set by the map, and that at a quarter, one and four times a domain's framing zoom every drawn box carries no text size of its own: the camera never changes a label.

title: Each label line is drawn at its map size times the zoom, and one too small as a bar
when: For every box of the Tree and Nested maps of the test workspace.
then: Expects each label line's size to be its face's (`TITLE_FONT` or `META_FONT`) times the box's text scale, the whole line inside its box, and every badge inside its box.

title: Only boxes, bars and lines on the canvas are drawn, placed relative to the camera's center
when: Places boxes inside and past each edge of a 1000 by 800 pane, one far off at a quarter zoom, and two deep in a very large map at a very deep zoom.
then: Expects a box on screen drawn, one just past an edge kept for the margin its edge reaches, and one wholly past it culled; a line across the pane drawn and one below it culled; a far box coming into view when the camera zooms out about the same center, and a tiny box deep in a very large map, at a very deep zoom, placed as exactly as one near the origin.

title: The map draws exactly one line per relationship link and one per entity and aggregate it references
when: Builds the product's map.
then: Expects one line for each of the two has_one and has_many links between entities, five reference lines (Loan's two references to Member from two entities), no line ID twice, the reference `P-D-EN05|references|P-D-EN02` worded `references by ID` with the hover `Reminder.Member`, and the key's `Reference by ID` entry titled "A field holds the other aggregate's ID; the line points at its root."

title: Every leaf record is one size and every container exactly as big as what it holds, in reading order
when: Lays out the test product's Map and the grouped workspace's.
then: Expects every leaf record 240 by 84 at text scale 1, every container's children inside its padding below its header band, none overlapping, reaching its right and bottom padding, and each container's children in reading order, row by row.

title: The product is the ground, its shared district first, then each domain, its stages left to right in stage order
when: Lays out the test product's Map and the grouped workspace's.
then: Expects the product as the ground holding its shared district and then its domains in ID order, each district's neighborhoods left to right in stage order on one row, each holding areas or records, and each node counting the records it holds.

title: The layout's worker lays the Map out as the page does
when: Packs the test product's Map input, unpacks it as the layout's worker does and lays both out.
then: Expects each node's role kept, the product the ground, the same boxes from both, and no roles in a Tree input.

title: A change on the Map keeps every box where it was unless a container that grew now covers it
when: Lays out a product's Map, then adds, removes, renames and moves a requirement, or gives a record a problem, and lays it out again from the Map before; then removes a requirement and adds another; then lays it out afresh.
then: Expects every box outside the changed containers at its size and at its place inside its parent unless a sibling that grew now covers where it was, no changed container smaller, no two siblings overlapping, nothing moved by a problem badge, the same Map again for unchanged data, a removed requirement's room kept and taken by the next one added, and Tidy up giving a first layout's picture.

title: Keys are shown as the platform shows them
when: Formats bindings for a Mac and elsewhere, then opens a use case on a Mac and reads the tooltips, Go to… and the palette.
then: Expects `⇧⌘P`, `⌥⌘F`, `⌃-` and `⌥1` on a Mac and `Ctrl+Shift+P` and `Alt+1` elsewhere; then `⌘B` in the navigation toggle's tooltip, `⌥1` on the first space, `⌘P` on Go to…, `⌃G` on the palette's graph stage row, and `⌃G` and `⌃E` on the Graph and ERD buttons.

title: Every control with a shortcut has aria-keyshortcuts
when: Turns key lists into `aria-keyshortcuts` values, then opens a use case off a Mac and switches to the Graph stage, stepping its depth to 2.
then: Expects `aria-keyshortcuts` of `Control+B` on the nav toggle, `Control+P Control+K` on Go to…, `Alt+1` on the first space, `Control+Shift+M` on Checks, `Alt+G Control+1` and `Alt+E Control+2` on the stage switch's buttons off a Mac, `Enter Alt+W` on the wiki card toggle, `Plus =` and `-` on the depth buttons and `.` on Frame the focus, and none for a sequence.

title: A color below WCAG AA while editing gets a warning beside its swatch
when: Duplicates the Lathe theme and sets its light muted text to `#B0B0B0`.
then: Expects two contrast warnings in the light cell, the first `1.99:1 on Paper; needs 4.5:1`, and none in the dark cell.

title: Each folder window reopens where it was left, and always on a screen
when: Saves windows for several folders, then places them against one or two screens.
then: Back where they were, centered when off every screen, shrunk to the largest screen, and never below the minimum size.

title: A second launch or a folder from Finder goes to the running app, which opens or focuses its window
when: Reads the folder from unpacked and packed command lines, routes a second launch to open its folder (relative to where it was launched) or to bring the app forward, routes a folder from Finder now or once ready, and finds an open folder's window however its path is spelled.
then: Expects the folder read from an unpacked and a packed command line with flags ignored, and none from one without a folder; a second launch's folder resolved from where it was launched, or the app brought forward when it names none; and a folder from Finder or the Dock opened at once when the app is ready and later when it is not, its trailing slash dropped.

title: Whole-ID matching
when: Loads a test whose file names its ID alone, in parentheses and at the end of a line, then files naming only longer IDs that start or end with it.
then: Expects the ID found in the first and not in any of the others.

title: Allowed test levels
when: Reads `ALLOWED_LEVELS`, the levels each test kind may run at.
then: Expects the levels each test kind allows, and every level for a pattern rule test and a standard rule test.

title: Source files leave out tests, configs, generated files and build output, and a named folder traces what it holds
when: Lists the source files of a folder that holds four source files beside tests, test helpers, configs, a generated file, build output, a README and another product, with the default globs, narrower ones and wider test globs; then asks which files a record's named file and folder trace.
then: Expects only the four source files by default, only the matching ones with narrower globs and none the test globs name, and a file traced when a record names it, a folder holding it or `.`, never one whose name only starts like the folder's.

title: Routes written each way have one normal form
when: Puts routes with each parameter syntax, a query string, a trailing slash and regular expressions through the normal form.
then: Expects one form for each route however it is written, the root kept, and no route for a regular expression that matches more than a path.

title: Each test case is read with its line, full name and IDs, and nothing from strings or comments
when: Reads test files with Vitest and Playwright forms, nested describes, each rows, and test-like text in strings, template literals, comments and regular expressions.
then: Expects each test case with its line, its name after its describes' and the whole IDs it names, and nothing read from strings, comments, regular expressions or calls that are not test cases.

title: A record serves the outcomes of the capabilities of the use cases that reach it, and nothing else
when: Works out the reach over the complete product, then with a second capability serving a second outcome, a domain following a pattern, and no outcome served at all.
then: Expects each record the use cases reach through steps, commands, queries, events, policies, views, endpoints, integrations, patterns, technical records, standard rules and tests to serve the outcomes of their capabilities, the union where several reach it, and nothing reached when no outcome is served.

title: A product's own relations carry the reach both ways
when: Loads a product with a script kind, a relation from a script to an aggregate and one from a script to a standard rule, one script listed in a reached aggregate and honoring an unmet rule, and one script linked to nothing.
then: Expects the listed script and the rule it honors reached by the aggregate's use case, and the unlinked script reached by nothing.
